mil7.7.2:1.1: ‘‘Bhante nāgasena, ‘thanassitadārakassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabba’nti yaṃ vadesi, katamaṃ taṃ ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabba’’nti?
mil7.7.2:1.2: ‘‘Yathā, mahārāja, thanassitadārako sadatthe laggati, khīratthiko rodati,
mil7.7.2:1.3: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena sadatthe laggitabbaṃ, sabbattha dhammañāṇena bhavitabbaṃ, uddese paripucchāya sammappayoge paviveke garusaṃvāse kalyāṇamittasevane.
mil7.7.2:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, thanassitadārakassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.2:1.5: Bhāsitampetaṃ, mahārāja, bhagavatā devātidevena dīghanikāyavare parinibbānasuttante –
mil7.7.2:2.1: ‘‘‘Iṅghaṃ tumhe, ānanda, sāratthe ghaṭatha, sāratthe anuyuñjatha; Sāratthe appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharathā’’’ti.
